statements.status_notes: Upstream merge request https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/merge_requests/5340 adds O_NOFOLLOW to handle_overwrite_open(), closing the TOCTOU symlink race in g_file_replace() when G_FILE_CREATE_REPLACE_DESTINATION is used. Debian trixie glib2.0 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 has no fixed package version yet; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-86469.

Disputed by vendor. The existence of the g_str_hash function is not a vulnerability in the library, because callers of g_hash_table_new and g_hash_table_new_full can specify an arbitrary hash function that is appropriate for the application.
